Nearshore vs. Offshore React Development

Your decision about the type of React development services should be based on your project’s specifics and your budget. Nearshore React development implies recruiting people from the country within your geographical region. It grants you more control and easier communication during the development process, however, the price will be significantly more than if you were to choose an offshore team. 

Another option you have is offshore React development. In this case, you would be hiring developers from far away. This option is great for those who have a tight budget or want to expand their search for the best specialists. More than that, offshore development companies often take care of all the recruitment process so you will have to go through no React JS developer resume on your own.
